submitted.rationale: Of the 5 compositions measured, index 11 (Sb 0.574) had the highest EQE at 0.285%. The next best was index 9 (Sb 0.49) at 0.124%. Index 18 (Sb 0.79) gave 0.012%, index 3 (Sb 0.29) gave -0.27% and index 13 (Sb 0.66) gave -0.11%. By XRD, indices 11, 13 and 15 contain the same Ag-Sb-O phase plus FTO substrate peaks, and the lattice contracts slightly as Sb increases. The drop in EQE at index 13 is therefore not explained by a change of phase.
